basecamp.name: Basecamp
basecamp.note: Two miles west of downtown Salida, on the river side of the highway. Look for the orange flag.

seasonNote: Basecamp is staffed 15 May to 31 August. Off-season, leave a message and we call back within a day.

season.peakNote: Runoff peaks in early June: the water is high, cold and fast. Pine Creek closes first; the Gorge opens last.
